test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to Census of India 2011, in which of the following states was the Scheduled Caste (SC) population NOT recorded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the 2011 Census of India, **Nagaland had no Scheduled Caste (SC) population**.
 
• The **2011 Census of India recorded no SC population **in Nagaland.
 
• **Nagaland** is the only state in India that recorded a negative population growth rate of -0.58%.
 
• The total population of **Nagaland in 2011 was 1,980,602**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
